Answer A presents all three fixes in order of impact and treats moving the unit to the header as a core fix, while Answer B labels it optional. Answer B is also inconsistent: its code formats to 2 decimals, but its final example shows 3. It is a bit more careful than A about whether Trebuchet MS has fixed-width digits. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B covers all three fixes in a sensible order.
